Primary GET /bff/runtimes returned HTTP 200 (so no_completed_route_data was not raised), while secondary GET /bff/management/persona-fleet returned HTTP 503/non-2xx (swallowed by .catch(() => []) in UI, but flagged as api_data_failure by accept-management-hosted-production.mjs).

Under check:management-crawl's identity=viewer (pantheon-dev-viewer-v1, roles=['viewer']), Governance _approval_reader rejects both with HTTP 403 ('Approval read role required'), yielding 0 valid route reads (no_completed_route_data) and status>=400 (api_data_failure).
